paragraphs: Unless otherwise noted, references in this Form 10-K to "we," "us," "our," "Company," or "Sezzle" refer collectively to Sezzle Inc. and our subsidiaries.

We are a purpose-driven payments company on a mission to financially empower the next generation. Launched in 2017, we have built a digital shopping and payments platform that provides consumers a flexible alternative to traditional credit. Through our products, we aim to give consumers control of their spending, ways to save money, and access to responsible credit. Our vision is to create a digital ecosystem benefiting all of our stakeholders—including merchants, consumers, employees, communities, and investors—while continuing to drive ethical and sustainable growth.

We launched Sezzle amid a backdrop during which digital shopping began to claim a larger share of the retail sector and younger generations (i.e., Gen Z and Millennials) started demonstrating a need for credit. Gen Z and Millennial consumers, who we define as individuals currently between ages 18–29 and 30–48, respectively, use credit cards less frequently than other generations and, in many cases, lack access to traditional credit. These same consumers are tech-savvy and gravitate towards modern, streamlined commerce solutions, whether online or in-person. Our platform addresses the shortcomings in legacy payment offerings consumers face by providing a flexible, secure, omnichannel alternative with the structural benefit of "creditizing" traditional debit products. The technology solutions we have designed align with our mission of financially empowering the next generation.

We believe our stakeholder approach gives us a competitive advantage and positions our company for success. Stakeholders want to be affiliated with a purpose-driven partner and, to that extent, we elected to become a Delaware public benefit corporation in June 2020. Public benefit corporations are for-profit corporations intended to produce a public benefit and operate in a responsible and sustainable manner. Under Delaware law, public benefit corporations must identify in their certificate of incorporation the public benefit or benefits they will promote, and their directors have a duty to manage the affairs of the corporation in a manner that balances the pecuniary interests of the stockholders, the best interests of those materially affected by the corporation's conduct, and the specific public benefit or public benefits identified in the public benefit corporation's certificate of incorporation. Being a public benefit corporation offers advantages, including:
•public benefit corporation status is a clear differentiator in an increasingly growing, and sometimes crowded, industry;
•we are more likely to become an employer of choice as the younger workforce increasingly seek employment from companies which align with their ethical values;
•further opportunities to conduct business with brands that also care about sustainability;
•the potential to expand our consumer base due to conscious consumers;
•added credibility to our mission statement and potential to grow capital through impact investing; and
•further opportunities for positive public relations and marketing.
We operate in the United States and Canada, and are currently winding down and exiting operations in India and certain countries in Europe.

The Sezzle Platform offers a payments solution for consumers that instantly extends credit at the point-of-sale, allowing consumers to purchase and receive the ordered merchandise at the time of sale while paying in installments over time.

The Sezzle Platform can be integrated into merchants' websites via pre-built widgets for select e-commerce platforms or our direct Application Programming Interface. Consumers can access the Sezzle Platform through the Sezzle mobile application or Sezzle online dashboard. We are able to rapidly onboard and integrate merchants through an increasingly automated merchant underwriting process and, once integrated, consumers can choose the Sezzle Platform as a payment method at the merchant's point-of-sale. The Sezzle Platform is presented alongside other payment options on the merchant's checkout page. Consumers then select Sezzle as their payment option and, if they are a first-time user, create an account with Sezzle in a quick and streamlined process integrated into the selected merchant's checkout. If a particular merchant is not directly integrated with us, consumers are still able to checkout with the Sezzle Platform using a virtual card if they are subscribed to Sezzle Premium (for select merchants) or Sezzle Anywhere (subject to certain merchant, product, goods, and service restrictions), or if they elect to use Sezzle On-Demand (as discussed below).

The Sezzle Platform reviews the transaction and consumer profile in real-time and, if approved, quickly confirms the transaction for both the consumer and the merchant. Once an initial transaction is approved, consumers are granted a spending limit. Our underwriting platform analyzes above-limit purchase attempts and may provide alternative terms to prevent a consumer from being denied outright. After a transaction is approved and merchant checkout is completed, the merchant ships the order and receives payment, just as if the consumer had paid in cash or used a traditional credit or debit card.

headings: We operate in a highly competitive industry, and our inability to compete successfully would materially and adversely affect our business, results of operations, financial condition, and prospects.
Negative publicity about us or our industry could adversely affect our business, results of operations, financial condition, prospects and share price.
Risks Related to Our Strategy and Growth
We have generated significant net losses in the past. We may not achieve or be able to maintain historic levels of profitability in the future.
If we fail to retain existing consumers or acquire new consumers in a cost-effective manner, our business, financial condition, and results of operations could be adversely affected.
If we fail to retain existing merchants or acquire new merchants in a cost-effective manner, our business, financial condition, and results of operations could be adversely affected.

We may not be able to sustain our total revenue growth rate, or our growth rate of related key operating metrics, in the future, and failure to effectively manage growth may adversely affect our financial results.
If we fail to promote, protect, and maintain our brand in a cost-effective manner, we may lose market share and our results of operations and financial condition may be negatively impacted.
We may require additional capital, and the terms of such capital may not be available on terms satisfactory to us, or at all.
Risks Related to Our Financing Program
We rely on the accuracy of third-party data, and inaccuracies in such data may lead to reduced total revenue.
Consumer bad debts and insolvency of merchants may adversely impact our financial success.
If our merchants fail to fulfill their obligations to consumers or comply with applicable law, we may incur costs.
Risks Related to Our Technology and the Sezzle Platform
Our results depend on integration, support, and prominent presentation of our platform by our merchants.
Unanticipated surges or increases in transaction volumes may adversely impact our financial performance.
Real or perceived software errors, failures, bugs, defects, or outages related to the Sezzle Platform could adversely affect our business, results of operations, financial condition, and prospects.
Any significant disruption in, or errors in, service on our platform or relating to vendors could prevent us from processing transactions on our platform or posting payments.
Fraudulent activities may result in us suffering losses, causing a materially adverse impact to our reputation and results of operations.
Other Risks Related to Our Business
The loss of key partners and merchant relationships would adversely affect our business.
Changes to our key operating metrics may negatively affect our business and reputation.
paragraphs: The BNPL industry has become subject to increased regulatory scrutiny, and our failure to manage our business to comply with new regulations would materially and adversely affect our business, results of operations and financial condition.

Regulators in various jurisdictions in which we operate are showing increasing attention and scrutiny of BNPL arrangements. We may become subject to additional legal or regulatory requirements if laws, regulations, or industry standards, or their interpretations and/or enforcement thereof, change in the future. This risk may relate to regulatory requirements concerning the lending and financing industry generally, BNPL arrangements, consumer protection or consumer finance matters, state lending licensing or other state licensing or registration requirements, data security and privacy, or similar limitations on the conduct of our business. There is a risk that additional or changed legal, regulatory and industry compliance standards may impose significant additional compliance costs, restrict our ability to expand in accordance with our current strategy, restrict some or all of our current business activities in certain jurisdictions, or even make it economically unfeasible for us to continue to operate our business as contemplated or at all. This would likely have a material adverse effect on our business, on our results of operations and financial condition, including by preventing our business from reaching sufficient scale.

We cannot currently assess the likelihood of any future unfavorable legislation or regulations being proposed or enacted that could affect our products and services in the various jurisdictions in which we operate. In January 2025, control of the executive branch of the U.S. government changed as well as some changes in the legislative branch, which may have a significant impact on existing and contemplated financial services laws. Additionally, executive orders and other executive actions, including the new administration's direction that the CFPB suspend rule-making implementations and cease supervisory activities, have been issued with direct and indirect impacts on financial services regulation. U.S. state regulators also have broad discretionary power and may impose new licensing requirements, interpret or enforce existing regulatory requirements in different ways or issue new administrative rules that could adversely impact our business or require us to terminate or modify our operations in a particular state. We closely monitor proposed legislation in the jurisdictions we offer products and services. For more information, see "Risks Related to Our Regulatory Environment."

We operate in a highly competitive and dynamic industry with a low barrier to entry, which makes increased competition more likely. Our technology platform faces competition from a variety of existing businesses and new market entrants of consumer credit, including, but not limited to banks, non-bank lenders, retail-based lenders, other financial technology lending platforms, competitors with BNPL products and those who enable transactions and commerce via digital payments, such as mobile wallets, and legacy payment methods, such as debit and credit cards.

Despite any competitive advantage we may have, there is always a risk of new entrants in the market, which may disrupt our business and decrease our market share. We expect competition to intensify in the future, both as emerging technologies continue to enter the marketplace and as large financial institutions increasingly seek to innovate their offered services. In addition, deregulation of our industry, including as a result of policies adopted by the new administration, may encourage additional market entrants. Technological advances, including investment in artificial intelligence (AI), and the continued growth of e-commerce activities have increased consumers' accessibility to products and services and led to the expansion of competition in digital payment options such as pay-over-time solutions. We face competition in areas such as: flexibility on payment options; duration, simplicity, and transparency of payment terms; reliability and speed in processing applications; underwriting effectiveness; compliance and security; promotional offerings; fees; approval rates; ease-of-use; marketing expertise; service levels; products and services; technological capabilities and integration; customer service; brand and reputation; and consumer and merchant satisfaction. In addition, it may be become more difficult to distinguish our platform, and products and services, from those of our competitors.

Some of our competitors are substantially larger and have greater financial, technological, operational and marketing resources than we do. These competitors may benefit from more diverse product offerings, broader consumer and merchant bases, established distribution channels, stronger brand recognition and loyalty, longer operating histories and access to lower cost funding. They may also be able to cross-subsidize products and invest more heavily in technology, acquire competitors, or offer more favorable pricing or incentives to merchants and consumers.

paragraphs: The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations should be read together with our consolidated financial statements and related notes appearing elsewhere in this Form 10-K. This discussion and analysis may contain forward-looking statements that involve risks, uncertainties and assumptions. You should review the "Forward-Looking Statements", "Factors Affecting Results from Operations", and "Risk Factors" sections of this Form 10-K for a discussion of important factors that could cause actual results to differ materially from the results described in or implied by the forward-looking statements described in the following discussion and analysis.

We are a purpose-driven payments company on a mission to financially empower the next generation. Launched in 2017, we have built a digital shopping and payments platform that provides consumers a flexible alternative to traditional credit. Through our platform, we aim to give consumers control of their spending, ways to save money, and access to responsible credit. Our vision is to create a digital ecosystem benefiting all of our stakeholders—including merchants, consumers, employees, communities, and investors—while continuing to drive ethical and sustainable growth.

The Sezzle Platform offers a payments solution for consumers in the United States and Canada that has the ability to instantly extend credit at the point-of-sale, allowing consumers to purchase and receive merchandise, while paying in installments over time. Consumers pay a portion of the purchase price at the point-of-sale as a down payment, and then pay off the remaining amount over time through scheduled payments. We also offer the ability to "pay-in-full" using the Sezzle Platform.

We provide consumers access to subscription products, short-term credit products at the point of sale, which may be free or subject to fees and/or interest, and access to interest-bearing loans with our third-party partner. We make a majority of our revenue from merchants, partners, consumer fees, and through our two paid versions of the core Sezzle experience: Sezzle Premium and Sezzle Anywhere. Sezzle Premium is a paid subscription service for consumers to access large, non-integrated premium merchants for a recurring fee. Sezzle Anywhere is a paid subscription service that allows consumers to use their Sezzle Virtual Card at any merchant online or in-store, subject to certain merchant, product, goods, and service restrictions, for a recurring fee. Sezzle On-Demand allows consumers who are not subscribed to Sezzle Anywhere to use the Sezzle Platform at any merchant online or in-store (subject to the same restrictions as Sezzle Anywhere) in exchange for a finance charge, which is added to the consumer's initial down payment. Additionally, through collaboration with a third-party partner we enable our consumers access to interest-bearing monthly fixed-rate installment-loan products at participating merchants for larger-ticket items (up to $15,000), which extend up to 48 months.
We primarily operate in the United States and Canada, and are currently winding down and exiting operations in India and certain countries in Europe.
The following key factors have affected our financial performance and are expected to impact our performance going forward.

Our ability to profitably scale our business long-term is reliant on creating a transparent and sustainable ecosystem of products and services that add value for all of our stakeholders, including our consumers and merchants. We stand at the intersection of digital shopping and a need for credit for consumers who prefer to use credit alternatives other than credit cards or do not have access to traditional credit products. We provide consumers access to subscription products, short-term credit products at the point of sale, which may be free or subject to fees and/or interest, and access to interest-bearing loans with our third-party partner.

We earn fees from our merchants predominately based on a percentage of the GMV value plus a fixed fee per transaction, collectively called a "merchant processing fee." We generally pay our merchants the full transaction value upfront, net of the merchant processing fee owed to us, and assume all costs associated with consumer payment processing, fraud, and payment default. We also earn income from partners, including interchange fees through our virtual card solution, promotional incentives with third parties, and marketing revenue earned from affiliates. Our merchants have access to a toolkit we provide that can assist in the growth of their businesses. This toolkit includes marketing placements, co-branded marketing, exclusive promotions for consumers using Sezzle, and Sezzle Capital, which facilitates access to small business loans issued by third-party lender.

Our ability to profitably scale our business relies on the acquisition, monetization, and retention of consumers on the Sezzle Platform. Changes in our consumer base have had, and will continue to have, an impact on our results of operations. The success of our business depends on a consumer base that actively engages with the Sezzle Platform. It is costly for us to acquire consumers; therefore, we aim to provide offerings to our consumers that keep them engaged within our ecosystem, such as our in-app product marketplace, price comparison feature, Payment Streaks, Earn tab, and Sezzle Up. High turnover in our consumer base could result in higher than anticipated overhead costs. There is a risk that we may lose consumers for a variety of reasons, including consumers shifting to competitors or other payment options, changes in the general macroeconomic climate, or changes in our underwriting.

Additionally, our results of operations are significantly impacted by our success in monetizing our consumer base who use the Sezzle Platform. A majority of our revenue is earned through consumers using the Sezzle Platform as a payment method when making purchases, especially when using the Sezzle Virtual Card, or when consumers choose to enroll in either of our optional, paid subscription services. There is a risk that we may be unable to successfully monetize consumers who actively engage with the Sezzle Platform, which could adversely impact our results of operations.

Our expanding product suite enables us to further promote our mission of financially empowering the next generation, and the adoption of these products by our consumers is expected to drive operating and financial performance.

In 2024, we launched Payment Streaks and Sezzle On-Demand. Our free Payment Streaks program enables consumers to ascend through loyalty tiers by consistently making on-time payments, with each tier providing additional benefits to consumers. Sezzle On-Demand allows consumers who are not subscribed to Sezzle Anywhere to use the Sezzle Platform at any merchant online or in-store (subject to certain merchant, product, goods, and service restrictions) in exchange for a finance charge, which is added to the consumer's initial down payment.

In 2025, we launched price comparison, the Earn tab, and Sezzle Balance. Price comparison is a feature in our product marketplace that provides consumers the ability to compare the price of a product across a variety of different merchants and receive notifications if the price drops. The Earn tab allows consumers the ability to save money through coupons, discounts, and playing games. Sezzle Balance allows consumers to preload funds into a digital wallet for a simplified repayment process.

We continue to seek out new partners to adopt our existing products and strategize on new products to complement our platform and core products, which we believe will have an impact on the continued growth of our business.

paragraphs: 除非另有說明，本 Form 10-K 所提及的 "we"、"us"、"our"、"Company" 或 "Sezzle" 均指 Sezzle Inc. 及其子公司。
我們是一家以使命為導向的支付公司，目標是財務上賦能下一代。我們於 2017 年成立，已建立一個數位購物與支付平台，為消費者提供一個較傳統信貸更靈活的選擇。透過我們的產品，我們旨在讓消費者掌握自己的開支、找到節省金錢的方法，並獲得負責任的信貸。我們的願景是建立一個數位生態系統，使所有利害關係人（包括商家、消費者、員工、社區及投資者）受益，同時持續推動倫理且可持續的成長。

我們在一個數位購物開始佔據零售業更大份額，且年輕世代（即 Gen Z 與千禧世代）開始展現對信貸需求的背景下啟動 Sezzle。我們將 Gen Z 與千禧世代定義為目前年齡在 18–29 歲與 30–48 歲之間的個人，這些消費者使用信用卡的頻率低於其他世代，且在許多情況下缺乏傳統信貸的存取權。這些消費者同時具備科技素養，傾向於使用現代、簡潔的購物解決方案，無論是線上或線下。我們的平台透過提供一個靈活、安全、跨通路的替代方案，解決消費者在傳統支付方案中所面臨的不足，並透過 "信貸化" 傳統提款產品的結構優勢。我們所設計的科技解決方案符合我們財務賦能下一代的使命。

我們相信我們的利害關係人取向為我們帶來競爭優勢，並使公司處於成功的位置。利害關係人希望與一個以使命為導向的夥伴合作，因此我們於 2020 年 6 月選擇成為特拉華州公共利益公司。公共利益公司是營利性公司，旨在產生公共利益，並以負責任且可持續的方式運作。根據特拉華州法律，公共利益公司必須在其章程中明確說明其將促進的公共利益或公共利益，且其董事有義務以平衡股東的財務利益、受公司行為影響的相關人士的最佳利益，以及公共利益公司章程中所明確說明的特定公共利益或公共利益的方式管理公司的業務。成為公共利益公司提供了許多優勢，包括：
•公共利益公司地位在一個日益成長、有時競爭激烈的產業中是一個明確的區隔點；
•我們更有可能成為年輕勞動力所尋求的僱主，因為年輕 workforce 趨向於選擇與其倫理價值觀一致的公司；
•進一步與也重視可持續性的品牌進行商業合作的機會；
•因有意識的消費者而擴大我們消費者基礎的潛力；
•為我們的使命聲明增添了可信度，並有潛力透過影響投資來成長資本；且
•進一步的正面公共關係與行銷機會。
我們營運於美國與加拿大，目前正逐步收縮並退出印度及歐洲部分國家的業務。
Sezzle 平台為消費者提供付款解決方案，可在結帳時即時延長信用，讓消費者在購買時即可取得所訂商品，並分期付款。

Sezzle 平台可透過預建的元件，整合至商家的網站，用於特定的電商平台或我們的直接應用程式程式設計介面。消費者可透過 Sezzle 手機應用程式或 Sezzle 線上儀錶板存取 Sezzle 平台。我們能透過越來越自動化的商家授信流程，快速上線並整合商家，一旦整合完成，消費者可在商家的結帳點選擇 Sezzle 平台作為付款方式。Sezzle 平台會與其他付款選項一同顯示在商家的結帳頁面。消費者隨後選擇 Sezzle 作為付款選項，如果是首次使用者，會在選定商家的結帳流程中，快速且流暢地建立 Sezzle 帳戶。如果某個商家並未直接與我們整合，消費者仍可透過虛擬卡使用 Sezzle 平台結帳（前提是他們訂閱了 Sezzle Premium（僅限部分商家）或 Sezzle Anywhere（受特定商家、商品、貨品與服務限制）），或選擇使用 Sezzle On-Demand（如後文所述）。
Sezzle 平台會在實時審核交易與消費者資料，若審核通過，會迅速確認交易，同時為消費者與商家確認交易。一旦初始交易被批准，消費者將獲得一個消費額度。我們的授信平台會分析超過額度的購買嘗試，並可能提供替代條款，以避免消費者被直接拒絕。交易批准後，商家完成結帳，發送訂單並收到付款，就如同消費者以現金付款或使用傳統信用卡或提款卡一樣。

paragraphs: 下列對我們財務狀況及營運成果的討論與分析，應與本表單 10-K 其他處所載之合併財務報表及相關附註一併閱讀。此討論與分析可能包含風險、不確定性及假設的向前看聲明。您應審閱本表單 10-K 中的「向前看聲明」、「影響營運成果的因素」及「風險因素」部分，以瞭解可能導致實際結果與向前看聲明中所述或暗示的結果有重大差異的重要因素。
我們是一家以使命為導向的支付公司，目標是財務賦能下一代。於 2017 年成立，我們已建立一個數位購物與支付平台，為消費者提供一個靈活的替代傳統信貸的選擇。透過我們的平台，我們旨在讓消費者掌握自己的開支、節省金錢的方式，以及獲得負責任的信貸。我們的願景是創造一個數位生態系統，使所有利害關係人（包括商家、消費者、員工、社區及投資者）受益，同時持續推動倫理且可持續的成長。
Sezzle 平台為美國與加拿大消費者提供一種支付解決方案，具有在結帳時即時延長信貸的能力，使消費者能夠購買並取得商品，同時分期付款。消費者在結帳時支付購買價格的一部分作為訂金，然後透過預定的付款計畫償還餘款。我們也提供透過 Sezzle 平台「一次付清」的選擇。

我們為消費者提供對訂閱產品、結帳時的短期信貸產品（可能免費或需費用及/或利息）以及透過第三方合作夥伴提供的有息貸款的存取。我們主要透過商家、合作夥伴、消費者費用以及我們核心 Sezzle 經驗的兩個付費版本（Sezzle Premium 及 Sezzle Anywhere）來獲取收入。Sezzle Premium 是一種付費訂閱服務，讓消費者以定期費用的方式存取大型非整合的高階商家。Sezzle Anywhere 是一種付費訂閱服務，讓消費者可以使用 Sezzle 虛擬卡在任何線上或實體商家使用（受特定商家、商品、貨品及服務限制），以定期費用為條件。Sezzle On-Demand 讓未訂閱 Sezzle Anywhere 的消費者可以在任何線上或實體商家使用 Sezzle 平台（受與 Sezzle Anywhere 相同的限制）以換取財務費用，此費用會加在消費者最初的訂金中。此外，透過與第三方合作夥伴的合作，我們讓消費者能存取參與商家提供的有息每月固定利率分期貸款產品，用於較高價值的商品（最高達 15,000 美元），貸款期限可達 48 個月。
我們主要在美國與加拿大運作，目前正在逐步結束並退出印度及歐洲某些國家的運營。
下列關鍵因素已影響我們的財務表現，並預期會影響我們未來的表現。
我們長期實現盈利擴張的能力，取決於建立一個透明且可持續的產品與服務生態系統，為所有利害關係人（包括消費者與商家）創造價值。我們處於數位購物與消費者偏好使用非信用卡信貸替代方案或無法取得傳統信貸產品的信貸需求之間的交點。我們為消費者提供對訂閱產品、結帳時的短期信貸產品（可能免費或需費用及/或利息）以及透過第三方合作夥伴提供的有息貸款的存取。

我們主要根據 GMV 值的百分比加上每筆交易的固定費用， collectively 稱為「商家處理費用」，從商家獲取費用。我們通常會在交易價值中先行支付給商家，扣除應支付給我們的商家處理費用，並承擔與消費者付款處理、詐欺及付款違約相關的所有成本。我們也從合作夥伴獲取收入，包括透過我們的虛擬卡解決方案的交換費用、與第三方的合作促銷激勵措施，以及透過合作夥伴賺取的行銷收入。我們的商家可以使用我們提供的工具包來協助其業務成長。此工具包包括行銷置放、共品牌行銷、專屬促銷活動（供使用 Sezzle 的消費者），以及 Sezzle Capital，這項服務協助小企業貸款的取得，貸款由第三方貸款機構發放。

本公司能以獲利方式擴展業務，取決於在 Sezzle 平台取得、運用及留住消費者。消費者基礎的變動已對我們的營運結果產生影響，並將持續產生影響。本公司業務的成功取決於積極參與 Sezzle 平台的消費者基礎。取得消費者對我們而言成本高昂；因此，我們致力於提供給消費者各種服務，使其持續參與我們的生態系，例如我們的應用程式內產品市場、價格比較功能、Payment Streaks、Earn tab 與 Sezzle Up。消費者基礎的高流動率可能導致高於預期的營運費用。我們可能因多種原因失去消費者，包括消費者轉向競爭對手或其他付款選項、總體經濟環境的變化，或我們的授信政策的變化。
此外，我們的營運結果受到我們在 Sezzle 平台成功運用消費者基礎的影響。我們的大部分收入來自於消費者在進行購買時使用 Sezzle 平台作為付款方式，特別是在使用 Sezzle 虛擬卡，或消費者選擇加入我們的可選付費訂閱服務。我們可能無法成功運用積極參與 Sezzle 平台的消費者，這可能會對我們的營運結果產生不利影響。
我們不斷擴充的產品組合使我們能進一步推動我們財務賦能下一代的使命，而消費者對這些產品的採用預期將推動營運與財務表現。

2024 年，我們推出了 Payment Streaks 與 Sezzle On-Demand。我們的免費 Payment Streaks 程式讓消費者透過持續進行準時付款來晉升忠誠度等級，每個等級都會為消費者提供額外好處。Sezzle On-Demand 讓未訂閱 Sezzle Anywhere 的消費者可在任何線上或實體商店商家使用 Sezzle 平台（受特定商家、商品、貨品與服務限制），以換取金融費用，該費用會加在消費者最初的預付金額上。
2025 年，我們推出了價格比較功能、Earn tab 與 Sezzle Balance。價格比較功能是我們產品市場中的一項功能，讓消費者能比較不同商家的產品價格，並在價格下跌時收到通知。Earn tab 讓消費者透過折扣券、折扣與遊戲來節省金錢。Sezzle Balance 讓消費者能預存資金至數位錢包，以簡化還款流程。
我們持續尋找新夥伴採用我們現有產品，並策劃新產品以補強我們的平台與核心產品，我們認為這將對我們業務的持續成長產生影響。

headings: 與我們產業相關的風險
我們所處的產業為高度競爭，若我們無法成功競爭，將會對我們的業務、營運結果、財務狀況及前景造成重大且不利的影響。
關於我們或我們產業的負面報導，可能會對我們的業務、營運結果、財務狀況、前景及股價造成不利影響。
與我們策略及成長相關的風險
我們過去曾產生顯著的淨虧損。我們可能無法在未來達到或維持歷史的獲利水平。
若我們無法以具成本效益的方式留住現有消費者或獲得新消費者，將會對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運結果造成不利影響。
若我們無法以具成本效益的方式留住現有商家或獲得新商家，將會對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運結果造成不利影響。
我們可能無法在未來維持總營收成長率，或相關關鍵營運指標的成長率，若無法有效管理成長，將會對我們的財務結果造成不利影響。
若我們未能以成本效益的方式促進、保護及維護我們的品牌，我們可能失去市場佔有率，且營運成果與財務狀況可能受到負面影響。
我們可能需要額外資金，而此類資金的條件可能無法符合我們的要求，或根本無法取得。
與我們融資計畫相關的風險
我們依賴第三方資料的準確性，若此類資料不正確，可能導致總營收減少。
消費者呆帳及商家破產可能不利於我們的財務表現。
若我們的商家未能履行對消費者的義務或遵守適用法律，我們可能產生成本。
與我們的科技及 Sezzle 平台相關的風險
我們的營運成果取決於商家對我們平台的整合、支援及顯著展示。
未預期的交易量衝刺或增加可能不利於我們的財務表現。
實質或被認為軟體錯誤、故障、蟲蟲、缺陷或中斷與 Sezzle 平台相關，可能不利於我們的業務、營運結果、財務狀況與前景。
若平台或與供應商相關之服務發生重大中斷或錯誤，可能導致我們無法在平台上處理交易或發放付款。
詐欺活動可能導致我們遭受損失，造成對我們聲譽與營運結果的重大不利影響。
其他與我們業務相關的風險
失去關鍵合作夥伴與商家關係將不利於我們的業務。
我們關鍵營運指標的變動可能對我們的業務與聲譽產生負面影響。
paragraphs: BNPL 產業已面臨更嚴格的監管審查，若本公司未能管理業務以符合新規範，將對本公司業務、營運結果及財務狀況造成重大且不利的影響。

我們在各經營司法管轄區的監管機構，對 BNPL 約定的關注與審查正在增加。若未來法律、規範、產業標準，或其解釋與執行方式有所變更，我們可能面臨額外的法律或監管要求。此風險可能涉及對貸款與融資產業的一般監管要求、BNPL 約定、消費者保護或消費者金融事項、州級貸款許可或其它州級許可或登記要求、資料安全與隱私權，或對本公司業務運作的類似限制。有風險顯示，額外或變更的法律、監管與產業合規標準，可能導致重大額外的合規成本，限制本公司依照目前策略擴張業務的能力，限制本公司在某些司法管轄區的部分或全部現有業務活動，甚至使本公司繼續按照預期或完全無法運作業務。這將對本公司業務、營運結果與財務狀況造成重大不利影響，包括阻止本公司業務達到足夠規模。

本公司目前無法評估任何未來不利的立法或規範被提出或通過的可能性，這可能會影響本公司在各經營司法管轄區的產品與服務。2025 年 1 月，美國政府行政部門的控制權已改變，同時立法部門也出現一些變動，這可能對現有及預期的金融服務法規產生重大影響。此外，行政命令及其他行政措施，包括新政府方向指示消費者金融保護局（CFPB）暫停規則制定與停止監督活動，已發佈，對金融服務規範產生直接與間接影響。美國各州監管機構也擁有廣泛的裁量權，可能施加新的許可要求、以不同方式解釋或執行現有監管要求，或發布新的行政規則，這可能會對本公司業務產生不利影響，或要求本公司在特定州終止或修改業務運作。本公司密切監測我們提供產品與服務的司法管轄區所提出的立法。如需更多資訊，請參閱「與本公司監管環境相關的風險」。
本公司經營於一個高度競爭且動態的產業，進入門檻低，這使得競爭增加的可能性更高。我們的科技平台面臨來自多種現有企業與新市場參與者的競爭，包括但不限於銀行、非銀行貸款機構、零售貸款機構、其他金融科技貸款平台、擁有 BNPL 產品的競爭對手，以及透過數位支付進行交易與商業活動的企業，例如行動錢包，以及傳統支付方式，例如提款卡與信用卡。

儘管本公司可能擁有競爭優勢，但市場上始終存在新參與者的風險，這可能會干擾本公司業務並降低市場佔有率。我們預期未來競爭將更加激烈，一方面因新興科技持續進入市場，另一方面因大型金融機構 increasingly 尋求創新其提供的服務。此外，產業去監管化，包括因新政府政策所導致，可能鼓勵更多市場參與者加入。科技進步，包括對人工智慧（AI）的投資，以及電子商務活動的持續成長，已提高消費者取得產品與服務的可及性，並導致數位支付選項如分期付款解決方案的競爭擴張。我們在以下領域面臨競爭：付款選項的靈活性；付款條件的期限、簡易性與透明度；申請處理的可靠性與速度；信貸評估有效性；合規與安全性；促銷方案；費用；批准率；易用性；市場營銷專業知識；服務水準；產品與服務；科技能力與整合；客戶服務；品牌與聲譽；以及消費者與商家滿意度。此外，可能更難以區分本公司平台與產品與服務與競爭對手的。
我們的一些競爭對手規模更大，擁有比我們更多的財務、科技、運營與市場營銷資源。這些競爭對手可能受益於更廣泛的產品組合、更廣泛的消費者與商家基礎、已建立的分銷渠道、更強的品牌認知與忠誠度、更長的運營歷史以及較低成本的資金來源。他們也可能能跨業務補貼產品，並更重視科技投資，或收購競爭對手，或提供對商家與消費者更有利的價格或激勵措施。
